title: Store-load boundary passes NaN: a "NaN" leaf reaches the live model and makes the next save undecodable
claim: store._poisoned returns False for float('nan') and for the string "NaN" (abs(nan) >= ABSURD is False), so QuarantiningStore.async_load hands those leaves to the loaders; in 3 of 515 single-leaf "NaN" substitutions over every d1-stores healthy payload the NaN reaches the live thermal model or the published payload, and in the same 3 the next save writes a bare NaN token that the following restart's orjson load refuses, dropping the whole accuracy and snapshots documents.
mechanism: _poisoned's float branch is `abs(value) >= ABSURD`; NaN compares False, so _sanitize keeps it although the module and _poisoned's own docstring say non-finite is quarantined. comfort_learning's from_dict reads `float(np.clip(float('NaN'), lo, hi))` = nan (np.clip propagates NaN) into learned_weight/evidence, published as data['comfort_learning']; DhwProfileLearner.apply_cooling_rate does the same into ThermalParameters.dhw_cooling_rate (the solver's input). The accuracy and snapshot savers then json.dumps the NaN as a bare token; Home Assistant's orjson load refuses it and moves the whole file aside, so the learned accuracy history and the snapshots are lost at the next restart. tests/finite_boundary.py's own module-level checks 'the boundary quarantines nan at every depth' and 'str-nan' print FAIL on this tree.

evidence.unit: leaves (of 515) whose NaN reaches the live model/published payload; same 3 make a stored document undecodable
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: other finder seats and this seat's fuzz shards running; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --fix: store._poisoned also returns True for a non-finite float or a string whose float() is non-finite (one line: `return not math.isfinite(value) or abs(value) >= ABSURD`), patched in memory

metric_definition: Count of single numeric leaves which, set to the string "NaN" and loaded through the real loaders plus one cycle, leave a non-finite value live/published or an undecodable store document.
phenomenon_property: No store load hands a loader a non-finite number in any spelling (float NaN/inf, or a string float() turns into one); every non-finite leaf is quarantined at QuarantiningStore.async_load, so nothing non-finite is installed live or re-saved.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D1/s2/nan_boundary.py  (every numeric leaf of every d1-stores payload; the seam is store._poisoned, one function)

null_control.note: the spelling the boundary does scrub ("Infinity") over the same 148 leaves reaches nothing; the effect is NaN-specific

proposed_fix_scope: store.py:_poisoned refuses non-finite floats (math.isfinite); add a NaN arm to tests/finite_boundary.py's run (its own module-level check already fails).
